text: marina: Quick UX flag — the in-product docs panel calls the table column 'Route' but the live Console header shows 'Path'. Users are getting confused in onboarding flows. oliver: I noticed that too when running the onboarding script with the sample app. small but noisy. jia: hmm, where exactly? screenshot? marina: top-right of the endpoints table in Projects > Routes (see attached screenshot). When you click the little info icon the panel that pops up (in-product docs) uses the word 'Route' everywhere but the main header and the pill use 'Path'. kevin: that's a terminology mismatch. We should keep the noun consistent across console + docs. Which term is canonical? oliver: product decided on 'Path' last quarter for routing docs. Docs content might still have older 'Route' copies. marina: ok — two follow-ups: 1) update in-product docs panel copy and crosslinks to match 'Path' 2) check aria labels for the info icon and links so screen readers don't read differing terms. jia: agree. Also a behavior nudge: when the docs panel link opens external docs we currently open in the same tab for mobile — which breaks the console. Can we open in new tab + add rel="noopener"? kevin: yes please. Small code snippet we can use in the component: ```html Docs ``` ashley: Accessibility nit — the info icon's aria-label currently says "more info about routes" which will be wrong after copy update. Also double-check keyboard focus inside the panel; focus isn't returned to the icon after closing. marina: good catch. For tracking: we should also ensure the crosslink includes UTM-like params so we can see which in-console help links are most used. docsbot: Note: there's an existing docs page "Routing vs Paths" at /docs/routing-vs-paths. Would you like an automated redirect or rewrite suggestion? jia: redirect is fine but keep canonical path /docs/paths. docsbot can create a PR suggestion for edits that replace 'Route' with 'Path' in the in-product content files? docsbot: I created a draft PR suggestion: replace term 'Route' -> 'Path' in help panel content (draft-docs-change-174512). kevin: awesome. Implementation plan: jia updates component to use target=_blank + rel, oliver will sweep console copy to 'Path', marina will update the help copy we maintain in the docs repo, ashley will validate focus/aria. I'll own tracking additions. Timeline: ship in next sprint — can we aim for Wed EOD? oliver: Wed EOD works for a small change. I'll push a UI patch and label it product-patch. jia: I'll follow up with a tiny PR to the UI component and include the snippet above. Will include tests for focus trapping and return focus on close. ashley: I'll add an a11y checklist to the PR and run keyboard + NVDA smoke tests. marina: thank you. Also one UX thought — can we add a subtle microcopy line in the docs panel header: "Terminology: Console uses 'Path'" so users who are reading older blog posts don't get confused? Short and opt-in. kevin: fine as long as it's short. Something like: "Note: Console labels this 'Path'. See docs for routing concepts." — and link to canonical page with tracking params. oliver: can someone drop final copy here so I can paste into the PR? marina: proposed: "Note: This console labels endpoints as 'Path' (docs use the same term)." ashley: tweak: "Note: This console labels endpoints as 'Path'. See docs for routing concepts." jia: locking on Ashley's version. I'll include that in the panel header and ensure it's hidden from screen readers to avoid verbosity — we can surface via aria-describedby on icon instead. kevin: action items: - marina: update docs repo copy + confirm redirects (refs docsbot draft) - oliver: console copy sweep + PR (product-patch) - jia: UI component changes (target/_blank, rel, aria adjustments) - ashley: a11y tests + checklist - kevin: add tracking params on crosslinks marina: adding these to the board now. I'll ping when draft PR exists. Thanks all :smile:
